card.name: CarCity
card.description: Run your own neighborhood car garage. Fix customers' cars, buy and customize your dream rides at the dealership, and race them down the drag strip. Grow from a single lift to the best shop in town, one job at a time.

card.name: Shutterbug Skies: Idle Camping
card.description: A cozy corner idler built to be your daily desktop companion. Help Kes search for and photograph beautiful bugs while you work, study, or relax. Upgrade your camera equipment, complete your creature collection, and discover 7 unique floating islands!

card.name: Nook Beasts
card.description: Digital monsters in the corner of your desktop! Hatch, Evolve, and Raise over 100 different beasts, and send them on adventures to grow stronger, earn rewards to upgrade your nook, and discover eggs from unknown species!

card.name: CATLINES
card.description: You're part of the sorting service, it's your final day on the job! Build your way through different worlds, use your skills, and deliver 8,196 cat-boxes to their owners. Drink milk, enjoy chocolate mint, sort every last cat-box to discover the mysterious gift waiting for you!

card.name: Tidy Up The Christmas Shop
card.description: Tidy up a cozy Christmas shop solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op! Find, carry and sort thousands of festive objects across 765 item types. Upgrade your gift sack, unlock a little Christmas magic, and bring order to the holiday chaos, one shelf at a time.

card.name: The Cardkov
card.description: Turn poker hands into weapons in this single-player, top-down extraction shooter. Collect discarded cards in the city's cold back alleys, build a hand, and use your new weapon to uncover the factory's secrets. Grab one more card, or make it back alive with the hand you've got.

card.name: The Cozy Tree Co.
card.description: The Cozy Tree Co. is a relaxing game about chopping, decorating and selling Christmas trees. Search the winter wonderland for the perfect tree, get creative with your decorating, and sell your creations to spread holiday cheer!

card.name: Wild Myth
card.description: An online co-op adventure where you and your friends hunt for proof of the world’s most dangerous myths. All for the views. Go live. Capture the chaos. Run. Cut it into viral content. Stay live. Stay alive.

card.name: Sardoinky
card.description: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.

card.name: Bar of Betrayal
card.description: A social deduction party game for 4-10 friends in a 1927 speakeasy. Regulars play the bar's games, find the body and vote out the killer. The killer stabs in secret, hides the body, mops the blood and blames someone else.

card.name: STRAY BULLET
card.description: Free-to-play cartoon shooter where YOU are the bullet. Hop, blast off with gunpowder, fly on flames and go kamikaze in online matches for up to 20 players, with bots and local split screen. 28 weapons, 5 maps, 4 modes. No pay-to-win.

card.name: Study With Me: Online
card.description: Your new favorite place to study. Create an avatar and share a cozy multiplayer library with friends while you work on real-life goals. Mix 80+ clothing and footwear options, bring your books and music, then unwind with coffee or chess.

card.name: SearchBattle
card.description: Search, turned into a battle. SearchBattle is a word party game for 1–8 players on a real search engine. Everyone searches one word for the same topic; hit counts and results decide the winner. Across many rules, what's tested isn't knowledge but "search power." What would you search?

card.name: The Useless Game
card.description: A completely useless videogame that politely asks you not to download it.

card.name: Tasty Business
card.description: In Tasty Business, turn small restaurants into a culinary empire. Manage your businesses, source fresh ingredients, and attract customers as you expand your empire. Challenges, flavors, and new connections await. Are you ready to become the culinary mogul?

card.name: Desert Diggers
card.description: Dig out a lost Egyptian city with up to 7 friends! Shovel deformable sand, haul fragile treasures together, survive cave-ins, snakes and sandstorms, and bury your friends alive when they least expect it. Dynamite is cheap. Friendships are not.

card.name: Little St. Files Mayhem
card.description: The Oval Office has a paperwork problem. Sort case folders, decipher damaged labels and put the archive in order alone or with up to 3 friends. Pass audits and upgrade your skills in a first-person filing game where every folder needs a home.

card.name: Junk Tower Together
card.description: What are friends for if not to build a tower out of junk together... In Junk Tower Together, take turns stacking the most ridiculous objects, balance on the brink of disaster, and build a crazy tower with a group of up to 8 players.

card.name: Ranchonauts
card.description: A slapstick co-op game about herding alien sheep across a dangerous frontier. Work solo or with up to 5 friends to keep your flock together through physics-fueled disasters, pay off your ship-repair debt, and get home in one piece.

card.name: My Little Shadow
card.description: A little daughter, right on your desktop. Choose a child to share your days with: she plays, draws you gifts, gets a little mischievous, and naps nearby while you work. Share snacks, play together, and grow closer at your own pace—without daily chores or guilt for being away.

card.name: Warehouse Drink Sorting Simulator
card.description: Nearly 300,000 drinks in one mountain. Work through six halls, starting with a handful at a time. Earn money for bigger totes, carts, a lift and a giant scoop, then hire robot cats to pick and stack with you. No timers, no fail states.

card.name: Achievement Clicker 2026 Pro
card.description: Unlock 100 achievements as you smash targets, reduce their health, and upgrade your hammer! Keep clicking, get stronger, and collect them all in Achievement Clicker 2026 Pro!

card.name: Anomaly Watch: Loony Park
card.description: The amusement park is closed for the night, but you are still watching it. Check the cameras, find what has changed among the rides and shops, and report it before the night is over.

card.name: Gridways
card.description: Traffic is your problem now. Draw roads, paint arrows, time the lights and stack overpasses so every vehicle reaches the right hub. Congestion costs you points - gridlock ends the round. Over 100 handmade puzzles, three difficulties, a level editor and Workshop support.

card.name: There is No Stress in Outer Space
card.description: An incremental game about a spaceship in outer space destroying asteroids and other strange objects. Take control of the spaceship's gun, shoot, earn money, make upgrades and unlock new weapons and targets.

card.name: Don't Stop The Pop!
card.description: Ready to turn a single kernel into an unstoppable popcorn machine? Build your strategy with a massive Skill Tree; discover dozens of flavors from salty to chocolatey, spicy to salted caramel, and fill the screen with pops! Earn more, pop more! Don't Stop the Pop! 🍿

card.name: Overtake: Taskbar Racer
card.description: Overtake is an idle racing game that lives on your taskbar, built for people who spend all day at the keyboard. Your car cruises along while you work, and every keystroke gives it an extra push. Collect skins and trade them on the Steam Community Market, climb the leaderboards and never stop moving.

card.name: Desk Top Soccer
card.description: Manage your football club from a corner of your desktop or in fullscreen. Pick the line-up, train, build up the club and take your team from the bottom division to the top at your own pace. In multiplayer, compete in leagues against managers worldwide and trade players on the Steam Market.

card.name: Ladder of Numbers
card.description: Ladder of Numbers turns arithmetic into combat skills: charge with addition, multiply into clones, fire with subtraction, divide to split. Climb its steps through thunderclouds and imaginary-number storms to the edge of the sky.

card.name: Breakdance Simulator
card.description: Breakdance Simulator is a wild party game that brings breakdancing to your living room. Every move is danced with real physics, so a perfect headspin and a spectacular faceplant are never far apart. Think you can build the ultimate routine?

card.name: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest
card.description: Fly into a brand-new Winx Club adventure! Play as Bloom, transform, take flight, and freely explore an open world inspired by the series. Unravel the mystery of the Festival of the 100 Moons.

card.name: Mars Inc 98
card.description: Mars Inc 98 is a retro Windows 98 styled incremental game about terraforming Mars. Mine ore, craft parts, build machines and launch rockets to turn the Red Planet from a dusty wasteland into a habitable world.

card.name: Brew & Dash
card.description: Jump, duck, accelerate, and run to test your reflexes by dodging obstacles and enemies, collecting ingredients along the way to brew potions, gaining new powers, and going even further. Face challenges on randomly selected maps in this new take on the genre.

card.name: Don Memo
card.description: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.

card.name: XX Fulfillment Center
card.description: You've been hired as a Part-Time Contract Packaging Worker at the fulfillment center.Can you find your own happiness amid the speeding conveyor belts and ever-growing list of rules?

card.name: Dead Man's Pass
card.description: Inspect travel passes and question the strangers who reach your mountain gate after dark. In this yokai inspection game, compare every face, paper, and answer, then let them pass, turn them away, or draw your sword. Your family and the village bear the cost.

card.name: Daughter of Dawn
card.description: Only you can shape her destiny. Raise and guide the last princess of a fallen kingdom. Through friendship, love, growth, and loss, your choices determine her future. An emotional life simulation RPG with dozens of endings.

card.name: Mountain Rescuers
card.description: A co-op zombie FPS for 1-4 mountain rescuers who are not very good at rescuing. Arrive by flying rowboat, find the one survivor on each peak and keep it quiet: noise brings the horde. Sell the bodies to the butcher, buy bigger guns, try not to shoot your friends.

card.name: MOTHERLODE
card.description: Dig into a persistent world of prospecting, mining and industrial engineering. Discover finite deposits, excavate real material, process it through machines, build power, water and logistics networks, sell your haul, upgrade your operation, and expand your claims alone or with friends.

card.name: Ragnarok Mining Co.
card.description: Ragnarok Mining Co. is a satisfying planet demolition interval clicker set in a dystopian future where you are just a number in the corporate world. Scan for hotspots, fire your probes, and destroy worlds.

card.name: Space Couch Command
card.description: One person buys and installs it on the TV. Everyone else scans the QR code and their own phone or laptop becomes a bridge station, no install, no second copy. Nobody aboard sees the whole picture, so the ship only works if you talk. Crews of 1 to 9, and death is permanent.

card.name: Order Filled: A Trading Desk Story
card.description: Your first job on a trading desk, 2010. Each morning your supervisor hands you Tickets: a client's order to work, shares the desk wants gone, each with a deadline and a limit. You work them in a trading terminal, and the desk grades how you worked, not what you made. A story-driven job sim.

card.name: Dustronauts
card.description: Clean up dusty alien worlds alone or with up to 16 players in this relaxing space cleaning simulator! Vacuum endless dust, upgrade your equipment, automate your operations, and build your own space cleaning empire with friends.

card.name: StackProsper
card.description: Drop one card onto another and watch a 13th-century kingdom grow. Gather, build and raise your people, survive the seasons and hostile neighbors, then win by conquering their capitals or completing a grand cathedral.

card.name: Incremental Ants
card.description: Hatch ants. Explore parks. Steal picnic baskets. Incremental Ants is a game about growing an ant colony. Gather food using a variety of ants, upgrade their skills, unlock new species, and expand into territory where no ant has gone before.

card.name: Pastelaria Idle
card.description: Run a Brazilian pastel shop in first person: roll the dough, fill, fry and serve every pastel with your own hands. Hire staff, build your shop your way and grow from one kitchen to outer space, solo or with up to 10 friends online.

card.name: Silicon Life: From Bedroom to Billion
card.description: September 1981. A bedroom, a workbench, a dream: build a computer empire. Assemble, repair and sell PCs in 3D through the real hardware of 1981 to 2025 under parodied names, from the garage to the factory, and aim for a billion.

card.name: My Cat Companion
card.description: Your desktop is too quiet. Pick a cat. Paint their fur. One stalks your cursor. One reacts to every click and key. One bounces when tossed. Try to get work done. You answer to them now.

card.name: Hotel Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
card.description: Free introduction to the full version of Hotel Simulator. Take your first steps toward running your own motel. Design interiors, take care of your guests, and earn money. Begin your journey by paying attention to every detail.

card.name: Stacko
card.description: In Stacko, remember your childhood while earning awesome prizes that change the way you play. Your goal is simple: stack the blocks as high as you can! Earn cards to modify the machine and plushies with powerful bonuses, all while playing this unique twist on the classic arcade experience.

card.name: BumperMania
card.description: A car crashing arena game with a voxel look that you can play online with friends. Ram the other cars until they fall apart, or push them off the edge. There are all kinds of silly weapons around too. Last car standing wins. You can play PvP or PvE.

card.name: Escape the Walls
card.description: You're surrounded by walls. All you have on you is your hands. You have to punch your way through, no other choice.

card.name: Wood You Siege?
card.description: Lay siege to the forest in a short, chaotic incremental roguelite. Build an absurd arsenal, adapt to powerful random upgrades each run, and expand a massive skill tree to make every siege stronger than the last.

card.name: Dominos
card.description: Dominos is the classic tile game reimagined with multiple modes, tactical depth, and stylish customization. Play solo or with friends, battle players online, climb the ranks, unlock cosmetics, and make the experience your own.

card.name: Indie City Mixtape 2026
card.description: The Indie City Mixtape features seven small games, all contained within a 3D Platformer launcher. Ranging from shaving llamas to horror narrative, there's something for everyone in this ABSOLUTE BARGAIN of a collection!

card.name: Pawcision
card.description: Pawcision is a 2D retro-style LITERAL Precision Platformer with an Interactive Music System. Play as a cat with one goal: climb as high as you can. Like a cat, every jump you make must be PRECISELY calculated. Customize your look and conquer challenging obstacles with pixel-perfect reflexes.

card.name: Trick-Taking Rogue
card.description: Trick-Taking × Roguelike! Trick-taking games fused with roguelike elements like skills and shops! Features 9 trick-taking games including Spades, Oh Hell, and Schnapsen!

card.name: Minato
card.description: Minato combines classic minesweeper with roguelike elements. Progress through increasingly challenging stages, discover unique items, and face guardians that add unexpected twists before proceeding to the next floor.

card.name: Gladiadorks
card.description: Gladiadorks is a goofy online co-op gladiator brawler. Slap your knocked-out friend awake, throw rivals across the arena and fight lions, elephants and a giant on your climb from a muddy village ring to the Colosseum.

card.name: Grass Planet
card.description: Stranded on an alien planet, you must mow endless grassy hills to uncover the materials needed to rebuild your ship. Upgrade your lawnmower and uncover the mystery of the planet in this short incremental adventure.
